ssl-mode.help: SSL/TLS mode for encryption & decryption of traffic.

options.name: full
options.help: Client to FortiGate and FortiGate to Server SSL.

ssl-send-empty-frags.help: Send empty fragments to avoid attack on CBC IV (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only).

options.help: Allow a SSL client to renegotiate.

options.name: deny
options.help: Abort any SSL connection that attempts to renegotiate.

options.name: secure
options.help: Reject any SSL connection that does not offer a RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation Indication.

ssl-algorithm.name: ssl-algorithm
ssl-algorithm.help: Relative strength of encryption algorithms accepted in negotiation.

options.name: high
options.help: High encryption. Allow only AES and ChaCha.

options.name: medium
options.help: Medium encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, and RC4.

options.name: low
options.help: Low encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, RC4, and DES.
